svg.title: B2, the graph alone: top-label reliability at 100%, 50% and 25% evidence
svg.desc: Raw scores: the graph's posterior, a softmax of its log-likelihoods. EXP-007's rule chose Platt scaling for B2; the raw scores are drawn here. Each point is a 0.1-wide bin of the probability given to the first-ranked condition: across, the bin's mean probability; up, the share of its patients whose first-ranked condition is the true one. The diagonal is perfect calibration. Hollow points hold fewer than 20 patients; the bars below count each bin's patients. ECE over 10 equal-width bins, with its 95% bootstrap interval (1,000 resamples, seed 42). Validation split, 33,963 patients. DDXPlus is synthetic, so these figures describe its generator, not real patients. Closed world: only 13 conditions can be named (R-13). Evidence masked by docs/05 §3.7 (digests e99a7a8fbf792675 / af3a357f6454838a): the same patients at every level, each 25% history inside its 50% one; the masks remove answers at random, which a clinician's questions do not. The component alone, not fused. EXP-023. B2 is the knowledge graph alone, built from the DDXPlus definitions that generated these patients, so its figures are circular (R-12).
